lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har suaamee har prabh tin mile jin likhiaa dhur har preet ||
lines.translation: They alone meet the Lord, the Lord God, their Lord and Master, whose love for the Lord is pre-ordained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa gur bachan japio man cheet ||1||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, chant it consciously with your mind. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਭਾਗਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har prabh sajan loR lahu bhaag vasai vadabhaag ||
lines.translation: Seek the Lord God, your Best Friend; by great good fortune, He comes to dwell with the very fortunate ones.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai dekhaaliaa naanak har liv laag ||2||
lines.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, He is revealed, O Nanak, and one is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਫਲ ਘੜੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dhan suhaavee saphal ghaRee jit har sevaa man bhaanee ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed, beauteous and fruitful is that moment, when service to the Lord becomes pleasing to the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kathaa sunaavahu mere gurasikhahu mere har prabh akath kahaanee ||
lines.translation: So proclaim the story of the Lord, O my GurSikhs; speak the Unspoken Speech of my Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਉ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu paaeeai kiu dekheeai meraa har prabh sughaR sujaanee ||
lines.translation: How can I attain Him? How can I see Him? My Lord God is All-knowing and All-seeing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har mel dikhaae aap har gur bachanee naam samaanee ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, the Lord reveals Himself; we merge in absorption in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੋ ਜਪਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: tin vitahu naanak vaariaa jo japade har nirabaanee ||10||
lines.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice unto those who meditate on the Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਤੇ ਲੋਇਣਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har prabh rate loinaa giaan a(n)jan gur dei ||
lines.translation: One's eyes are anointed by the Lord God, when the Guru bestows the ointment of spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mai prabh sajan paaiaa jan naanak sahaj milei ||1||
lines.translation: I have found God, my Best Friend; servant Nanak is intuitively absorbed into the Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh a(n)tar saa(n)t hai man tan naam samaai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is filled with peace and tranquility deep within. His mind and body are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਪੜੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam chitavai naamo paRai naam rahai liv laai ||
lines.translation: He thinks of the Naam, and reads the Naam; he remains lovingly attuned to the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਈ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath paaeeai chi(n)taa gaee bilaai ||
lines.translation: He obtains the Treasure of the Naam, and is rid of anxiety.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliai naam oopajai trisanaa bhukh sabh jaai ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, the Naam wells up, and all hunger and thirst depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naame ratiaa naamo palai paai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who is imbued with the Naam, gathers the Naam in his lap. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh aape jagat upaai kai tudh aape vasagat keetaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself control it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰਾਇਅਨੁ ਇਕਨਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਤਿਨਾ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik manamukh kar haaraaian ikanaa mel guroo tinaa jeetaa ||
lines.translation: Some are self-willed manmukhs - they lose. Others are united with the Guru - they win.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਸਭਾਗੈ ਲੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ootam har prabh naam hai gur bachan sabhaagai leetaa ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, the Lord God is Sublime. The fortunate ones chant it, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਸਭੋ ਲਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਂ ਨਾਉ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh daalad sabho lahi gaiaa jaa(n) naau guroo har deetaa ||
lines.translation: All pain and poverty are taken away, when the Guru bestows the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਨੋ ਮਨਮੋਹਨੋ ਜਗਮੋਹਨੋ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਭੋ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sevahu mohano manamohano jagamohano jin jagat upaai sabho vas keetaa ||11||
lines.translation: Let everyone serve the Enticing Enticer of the Mind, the Enticer of the World, who created the world, and controls it all. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man a(n)tar haumai rog hai bhram bhoole manamukh durajanaa ||
lines.translation: The disease of egotism is deep within the mind; the self-willed manmukhs and the evil beings are deluded by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਞਾਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak rog vanjaai mil satigur saadhoo sajanaa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the disease is cured only by meeting with the True Guru, the Holy Friend. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤਾਮਿ ਸਗਾਰਵਾ ਜਾਂ ਦੇਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਨੈਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan taam sagaaravaa jaa(n) dekhaa har naine ||
lines.translation: My mind and body are embellished and exalted, when I behold the Lord with my eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਦੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak so prabh mai milai hau jeevaa sad sune ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meeting with that God, I live, hearing His Voice. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaga(n)naath jagadeesar karate apara(n)par purakh atol ||
lines.translation: The Creator is the Lord of the World, the Master of the Universe, the Infinite Primal Immeasurable Being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam dhiaavahu mere gurasikhahu har ootam har naam amol ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Lord's Name, O my GurSikhs; the Lord is Sublime, the Lord's Name is Invaluable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੋਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin dhiaaiaa hiradai dinas raat te mile nahee har rol ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on Him in their hearts, day and night, merge with the Lord - there is no doubt about it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee sa(n)gat milai gur satigur pooraa bol ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, they join the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, and speak the Word of the Guru, the Perfect True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਨਰ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੋ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੋ ਜਿਤੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਝਗੜੁ ਝਗੋਲੁ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabh dhiaavahu nar naaraaino naaraaino jit chookaa jam jhagaR jhagol ||12||
lines.translation: Let everyone meditate on the Lord, the Lord, the All-pervading Lord, by which all disputes and conflicts with Death are ended. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਉਦਿਆ ਸਰੁ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan har har chaudiaa sar sa(n)dhiaa gaavaar ||
lines.translation: The humble servant of the Lord chants the Name, Har, Har. The foolish idiot shoots arrows at him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har jan har liv ubare jin sa(n)dhiaa tis phir maar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the humble servant of the Lord is saved by the Love of the Lord. The arrow is turned around, and kills the one who shot it. ||1||
